selection: reuse existing allocation, never rescan all points or replace failures
row_order: frame ascending then original point ID ascending
transform: original stored RT times world homogeneous column, divide camera z, original K; no matrix repair/inverse/axis search
frame0_proper_rotation_fail: preserve and verify against saved diagnostic; not an annotation-consistency acceptance gate
failure_policy: stop on invalid required input/depth/arithmetic/unsupported schema or discrepancy > 0.5; retain attempted and unattempted rows, no replacement or retry
future_locking: shared design/sample locks plus new exclusive operation lock and persistent one-shot marker, new output only
future_execution_blocker: independent complete-input review then separate published canonical receipt and unmodified real gate

data_terms.modifications: only derived discrepancy/gate/status/count/hash summaries; no new source coordinates, camera coefficients or depth are redistributed
data_terms.scope_exception: old frame0 25-scalar exception remains historical and is not extended by this protocol

quaternion compatibility calculation without parent code review
public_output_scope: derived errors, statuses, hashes and counts only; no new K/RT coefficients, 2D/3D original coordinates, raw flags or other raw data; previous frame0 25-value exception is not expanded
